_doc: written by tools/author_race_furniture_blend.py — per-object counts and seating for tools/verify_race.py; ring_centres are the authored strip centres (engine frame x=E, y=up, z=N) for tools/plot_race_furniture.py. seated.hit = BVH deck under the ring centre, near = within 0.4 m (a ribbon fold's uncovered wedge), interpolated = from the run's seated neighbours. seat_gap_max_m is 0 by construction (base = deck - 0.05); the honest numbers are the seated counts, deck_vs_data (built deck minus data height + 0.10) and other_deck_above (another ROAD sheet above the strip base — a junction defect for its owner).
